result.reasoning_summary: The patch addresses the four specific missing boundary proofs identified in the previous review: valid port boundaries (0, 65535), explicitly valid empty indicators, invalid current time (negative/None), and malformed device/source/destination/evidence owner references. The changes are strictly test-only, with no modifications to runtime logic, network calls, or authority models. The acceptance criteria for FW-NET-002 remain intact, ensuring Evidence-first tenant-bound caller metadata and fail-closed validation. Since all previously identified blockers are resolved and no new issues are introduced, the patch is approved with low risk.
